exposure: maternal and fetal VEGF-A gene polymorphisms (rs2010963)
cohort: The cohort consisted of 221 pre-eclampsia patients with their partners and infants, and 345 normotensive women with their infants, all identified as Han Chinese pregnant women.
finding: The study found that both maternal and fetal VEGF-A rs2010963 polymorphism was associated with an increased risk of pre-eclampsia, and passive smoking significantly interacted with maternal rs2010963 polymorphism on the risk of PE.
